repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
t1 = (#Study_Temp).temperatureSensor_temperature
delay(20 MIN)
t2 = (#Study_Temp).temperatureSensor_temperature
diff = t2 - t1
if (diff >= 3) {
    (#Study_AC).airConditioner_setAirConditionerMode("cool")
}

diagnosis.summary: The candidate introduced an unnecessary absolute-value correction for the temperature difference (lines 4-7). The IR computes a signed difference ($t2 - $t1) and only triggers if that specific signed value is >= 3. The candidate's logic forces a positive difference even if temperature dropped (t1 - t2), causing the action to fire on a drop of 3 or more, which contradicts the IR.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the absolute-value correction block. Restored the condition to use the direct signed difference ($t2 - $t1) as specified in the IR, ensuring the action only fires when the temperature rises by at least 3 degrees.
